name: 狂想空间
english_description: A venerable Taiwanese MUD founded September 22, 1995 (by wade, shorst, jcder, and others), part of the ES II engine series shared with this project's es1_win, esI, xkx2001, rzrmud, and the Ode to Gallantry series. This project also holds another archive that likewise calls itself "Rhapsody Realm" (with added features like email registration) — comparison shows the two are independently circulated versions from different eras, and this is the earlier of the two snapshots.
